rationale: Absent or misleading local alarm can delay clinic recognition of an excursion.
Delayed remote notification reduces programme oversight but local alarm remains available.
Loss of all monitoring during a prolonged outage can leave excursion conditions unobserved.
Failure to recover backlog impairs later investigation while local monitoring remains available.
Presenting absent or faulty observations as acceptable conditions can mislead operational decisions.
An unauthorized automated disposition can cause use or disposal decisions without required programme evidence.
